topic: Deploying or updating the steady-orbit Cloudflare Worker via the Workers modules API - pulling the live bundle, overlaying module parts, multipart upload with metadata rebuilt from live settings, preserving crons and bindings, rollback

subtopics.scope: What the steady-orbit worker is (multipart ES module bundle: solar-rbs-entry.mjs entry + index.js + jev module family) and why deploys go through the Cloudflare REST modules API instead of wrangler.
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers modules API multipart upload script parts
Cloudflare REST API deploy worker script multipart form metadata part names

subtopics.scope: Pulling the live bundle with GET /workers/scripts/steady-orbit as the rollback source and part source of record, splitting parts on the response boundary, and the overlay pattern (ship everything else byte-identical).
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers script content GET download bundle parts boundary
Cloudflare worker deploy overlay single module part byte identical

subtopics.scope: Rebuilding multipart metadata from GET .../settings (main_module, compatibility_date, bindings verbatim), the keep_bindings error 10021 trap, and Secrets Store binding behavior.
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers script settings endpoint bindings compatibility_date
Cloudflare error 10021 keep_bindings invalid type mix

subtopics.scope: node --check plus import-graph resolution before upload; path-qualified fixture parts (fixtures/corpus-math-fixtures.mjs) and the CF 10021 'No such module' failure mode.
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers multipart upload 10021 No such module import
Cloudflare Workers module import graph resolve before deploy

subtopics.scope: Verifying schedules (cron preservation), bindings count, capturing result.etag as the deployed-code id, and live-verify of new routes.
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers cron schedules API scripts schedules endpoint
Cloudflare Workers deployment versions etag verify deploy

subtopics.scope: Post-deploy KV updates (SITE namespace, jev-index.html console, AGENT.md + llms.txt text docs), the json.dumps double-escape incident, raw --data-binary PUTs, and delayed re-GET byte-compare verification.
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers KV put value raw text namespace REST API

subtopics.scope: Rollback by re-PUT of the saved pre-deploy bundle, and importer coupling when parts are added (revert importers or keep the new part unused).
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers rollback previous deployment script versions
multipart worker rollback importer dependency module coupling

subtopics.scope: Deploy-safety rules: entry module byte-identical policy, CF 10182 fail on not-yet-existing secret bindings, secrets never riding the upload, unverified-math selftest rule.

Cloudflare Workers secrets store binding get runtime resolution
